annotations.text:
Progress screen, rebuilt against the real Midnight Blue tokens.

Three changes carry it:
1. An insight card leads, and says what to do.
2. The consistency matrix now carries FP, so behaviour and payoff sit on one row.
3. Compliance loses the three fat slabs.

Every number is BPM's real week of Aug 17.
Alternates for the two weakest pieces. Each carries its own tradeoff, not just a case for my favourite. Pick per card, they mix freely.
